description.value:
A spell-like ability has no components, normally takes a standard action, provokes, can be disrupted or used defensively with Concentration, is suppressed by anti-magic, and is subject to spell resistance when the duplicated spell is. It cannot counterspell or be counterspelled. Use the listed caster level, or Hit Dice if none is listed; the usual save DC is 10 + duplicated spell level + Charisma modifier.

This reusable record defines shared conversion behavior. Individual actors carry exact printed exceptions and totals.

system.source: World of Warcraft: Monster Guide, pp. 196
